title: Super Wonder Boy in Monster Land

accuracy.note: Independent sample of 29,177 comments; one branch-address detail corrected. A full audit and maintainer check remain open.
Continued coverage after sample 261110, including visual resource inputs, display fields and runtime-state scope. The sample describes the earlier 29,177-comment population.

Final sample: 60 of 21,215 written comments and 20 of 11,100 generated comments. Plain error rate 1.25%; stratum-weighted rate 1.7%. Corrected the same load/store-address wording across 29 loads; a full audit and maintainer check remain open.

Corrections made on 11 November 2026, after the game was merged: 30 comments moved to the rows they describe, eight leftovers of the imported listing removed, five comments corrected, and the hourglass routines named and described. The samples above measured the listing before these changes.

Corrections made on 16 and 17 November 2026 before the maintainer's sample: the four hidden-item routines and their contact handlers named for the money bag, coin, heart and hourglass they make, and the load-9 trigger that makes the hero immune to enemy contact described.

Maintainer's sample: 60 of 22,776 written comments and 20 of 9,543 generated comments; stratum-weighted rate 23 %. Fifteen of the 17 described bytes as unexplained characters of an eight-page character copy when the bytes are a load's compressed screen, tile definitions, sound pattern, record or message; that comment was corrected for 5,060 such character entries. One reference list stopped at four entries, corrected with 79 others like it, and one window check was off by one, corrected in all five copies of the routine. All 17 were then corrected.
